plan.summary: BRO-5776: 2026-27 Broadway slate audit against Playbill's 2026-10-20 schedule. Three announced shows lacked dates (so the Season Report missed them), The Full Monty was postponed on 2026-10-15, and two holiday specials were typed as plays.
steps: Date Three Days of Rain, Warriors and Rhinoceros (and fix Rhinoceros' first preview)
Clear The Full Monty's dates and set it to announced (postponed)
Type Now You See Me Live and Blue Man Group's holiday show as specials
